title: An unrecognised field in a finding is kept in its body, not a rejection of the tick's work
description: epic-gvc, 2026-09-25: 3h0's worker finished its tick and wrote a findings block where one finding carried an extra key, "title_note". The strict findings parser (internal/exec/subprocess/findings.go) refuses the whole report on any unknown key, so the attempt was rejected as finding_report_invalid and the run halted for a person. The work was fine; a person released it with carry-work. The strictness exists so a half-understood list never silently loses the half it did not understand. Keeping unknown keys inside the finding's body as a labelled line serves that goal without throwing away a tick's work over an annotation. Do this after nfo, which is extending the same record.
notes: 2026-09-25 23:04 - ticfac run epic-gvc: ryv try 1 (run dispatch #8) merged into epic/gvc as af453139e920; the integrated gate (go, ts) passed.
acceptance_criteria: A finding with an unknown key is accepted with the key and value appended to its body (and a note in the attempt's records that it was folded); missing required fields and invalid values still refuse; tests cover an unknown key, a missing key and a bad kind
